adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)`, the `else` branch for `!destination.credentialId` filters `this.calendarCredentials` by `c.type === destination.integration` and then does `Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event)))`. This means each such destination triggers event creation across *all* matching organizer credentials (M creates). If there are N destinations without `credentialId` (e.g., collective/team destinations), the loop repeats this, causing N×M remote creates (duplicates) rather than one targeted create per destination. Also, unlike the `credentialId` branch which passes `destination.externalId` into `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`, this else branch does not pass an externalId at all, so it cannot target the specific destination calendar.
